edition: Modern English Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
method: Every row read and compared, preserving stable IDs. Area labels come from the existing canonical candidate crosswalk. KHGuides covers 189 Sora treasures; its 14 Roxas rows were excluded. Remaining 112 matched to complete world walkthroughs and indexed item-location tables. All 144 puzzle rows compared to the complete Wizard table; sparse/contradictory routes received targeted numbered-Journal checks. These are source-supported working routes, not playtest certification or minimum-growth proofs.

sourceInspections.coverage: All 189 Sora rows, grouped across 12 worlds, matched by Journal number, reward and area. Disney 07 reward exception explicitly rejected.

Remaining 112 treasure route review, including Beast courtyard, throne side stairs, Fissure chest cluster, Mesa small/large pairs, late worlds and Cavern landmarks. Some mixed-edition locator mistakes rejected.
Twilight Town 23–39; erroneous repeated number 33 for chest 34 rejected.
Radiant Garden 15–22 and event access.
Radiant Garden 23–46; valves, elevator/wind approach, all Mineshaft sections, conveyors and post-Data chest.
Beast’s Castle 01–03 courtyard identities.
Agrabah 25–26 and timed-switch chamber access.
Land of Dragons 14–21 throne-room identities.
Land of Dragons 14–21; eastern recipe/AP and western shield/AP stair routes.
All 20 chests and page-unlocked areas; swapped Spooky Cave 15/17 source numbers rejected.
Port Royal 15–21 and shipwreck access.
Port Royal 16–18 upper wreck, anchor and beneath-ship routes.
Space Paranoids 11–14 and Solar Sailer access.
All 19 late-world chests; successive castle platforms and ramps.
All six tables, 144 puzzle pieces; compared location and movement against all existing rows. Contradictions are recorded below.
All 72 listed world-Journal rows inspected; exact area landmarks used where consistent. KHGuides incomplete-world coverage does not establish all 144.
World-numbered Final Mix puzzle facts; complete guide reviewed, with focused Station Heights, Chasm and Cavern checks. Guide is puzzle-only, not a complete treasure guide.
Bailey crown above Castle Gate exit; full Cavern valve, wind, piston and three-crown Glide route.
Chasm world pieces 10 on platform two, 11 on platform four, 9 while falling to bottom; world-ID mapping from KHWiki.
Naught’s Skyway and Ruin and Creation’s Passage return-glide launch points.

Actual paused HD frames01:04/01:07/01:09 reconcile Daylight27 roof/pillar;06:28/06:30/06:32 inspect Mineshaft physical positions without proving individual board-ID binding. See gap-closure-2026-10-02.md.

accessNotes: KHGuides, Wizard and KHWiki HTML inspected directly. GamerGuides accessible through the web retrieval service.
Fandom and TrueAchievements direct retrieval returned 402/403; search-indexed excerpts exposed the relevant tables and numbered passages.

Thundaka SuperCheats mirror was accessible through web retrieval; direct HTTP returned 403. GameFAQs, Neoseeker, PlayStationTrophies and KHdatabase direct endpoints were blocked; indexed PlayStationTrophies portions were accessible.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Mythril Shard identity preserved; only the trombone hedge locator adopted. KHWiki and 2.5 GamerGuides agree.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: GamerGuides swaps the numbered Orichalcum and Mythril Crystal Spooky Cave chests.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: 15 Orichalcum in left branch; 17 Mythril Crystal with Guard Recipe. Stable IDs preserved.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: GamerGuides repeats 33 for the stair Mythril Stone.
Fandom mixed-edition table swaps the two Moonlight Nook landmarks.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: KHGuides/PST Final Mix numbered mapping: 13 northeast; 14 west/stair base.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: Wizard Tram Common central pillar row.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Station Heights crown above Tram Common exit.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: Wizard platform/puzzle mapping and KHGuides world-number sequence disagree with the numbered Journal crosswalk.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Daylight 10 = Journal 11 = fourth platform; Daylight 11 = Journal 10 = second platform; Daylight 37 = Journal 9 = final falling crown.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: KHGuides calls the Curly Hill crown southeast.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Southwest retained; Wizard and Thundaka independently agree.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: KHGuides and Thundaka use conflicting east/west assignments around the Undercroft furniture piles.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Furniture/guarded-door landmarks retained without importing contradictory compass labels.

rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.rejected: Thundaka says Final Form Glide MAX is mandatory; modern walkthrough permits Glide LV3. Also, GamerGuides lists 32/36/40 together without establishing traversal order.
rejectedOrQualifiedClaims.accepted: Modern three-crown Glide LV3 route retained; no individual order or universal minimum asserted.

precisionResiduals.blocker: All three sources place the crowns on the upper Mineshaft pipe Glide route, but numbered tables and prose do not establish a reliable individual pipe segment/order. The complete sweep is provided for each; resolving order needs a modern numbered capture.
